records.student_text: A robot moves at a constant speed of 7 m/s. At first it moves east, then it turns and moves north while keeping the same speed. Compare its speed and velocity before and after the turn.
records.student_html:
A robot moves at a constant speed of 7 m/s. At first it moves east, then it turns and moves north while keeping the same speed. Compare its speed and velocity before and after the turn.

  1. Both speed and velocity remain constant because the speedometer value is unchanged.
  2. The speed changes but the velocity does not.
  3. Velocity has no direction, so only position changes.
  4. The speed remains 7 m/s, but the velocity changes because its direction changes from east to north.
choices: Both speed and velocity remain constant because the speedometer value is unchanged.
The speed changes but the velocity does not.
Velocity has no direction, so only position changes.
The speed remains 7 m/s, but the velocity changes because its direction changes from east to north.
records.answer: The speed remains 7 m/s, but the velocity changes because its direction changes from east to north.
